description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeAPI' within the OrangeHRM system. It handles HTTP GET requests to list employees available to be assigned as supervisors or subordinates for a specific employee, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination. The class extends a base Endpoint class and implements CollectionEndpoint, utilizing several traits, services, and validators for processing the request and generating the response.
